blocks.text:
After breakfast, transfer to the airport.

The Amazon part of your journey begins aboard the M/V Anakonda, staying in a Standard Suite.

The cruise lasts 5 days / 4 nights, from Wednesday to Sunday. Within the overall 9-day tour, the first four cruise days run from Wednesday to Saturday; on Sunday, you return to Coca and then Quito.

The Amazon programme follows the Napo River and nearby natural areas: the flooded forests of the Cuyabeno Reserve, Yasuní National Park and Pañacocha Lake, also known as Piranha Lake.

Cruise activities include an observation tower, jungle walks, canoe trips through blackwater habitats, visits to Amazonian communities and wildlife watching.

blocks.text: Wednesday. Quito – Coca – Yasuní National Park

provenance.wordAbsenceReason: Word day 2 describes this journey but does not contain this standalone heading.

blocks.text: Day 2 (Wednesday) · Breakfast and transfer to the airport for the 30-minute flight to Coca (Francisco de Orellana). A motorised canoe takes you about one hour along the Napo River to the M/V Anakonda, with its spacious social areas, comfortable suites and observation deck. The cruise sets off downstream; at dusk, an evening walk reveals the nocturnal life of the forest. (B, L, D)

blocks.text: Day 3 (Thursday) · After breakfast, a guided walk in the tropical rainforest to understand the relationships between its plants and animals. After lunch, the ship heads towards one of the most pristine and least explored parts of the Ecuadorian Amazon, home to pink river dolphins, black caimans, anacondas, river turtles, monkeys and the prehistoric-looking hoatzin, the “stinky turkey”; a canoe ride takes you through the flooded forest. (B, L, D)

blocks.text: Friday. Local community, activities on board and a Napo River island

blocks.text: Day 4 (Friday) · A visit to a school on the banks of the Napo River, to meet the children and learn about life in this remote community. Back on board, a lecture and documentary on the region’s biodiversity and conservation, and, time permitting, a handicraft workshop; in the afternoon, explore one of the largest river islands of the Napo. (B, L, D)
